verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports API key auth (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and Enterprise adds SSO, role-based permissions, and managed policy settings, suggesting some scoping capability at the org level, but there's no explicit evidence of issuing per-agent scoped/least-privilege API credentials (e.g., fine-grained token scoping for individual agent instances). The Agent SDK offers 'permissions' control over tool access, which is adjacent but not the same as credential scoping.
